callsign_prefix: # Brand rules: name the airline by WHO OWNS THE AIRFRAME when the callsign
# alone gives the wrong answer or no answer.
#   callsign_prefix       ICAO prefix this rule applies to. Blank = aircraft
#   registration_pattern  regular expression matched against the tail number
#   owner_contains        text that must appear in the registered owner
# A row matches when the prefix matches AND the registration pattern or the
# owner text matches. First match wins.
# Hawaiian Airlines aircraft fly under Alaska's ASA callsign and AS flight
# numbers since the two airlines combined operations
# Hawaiian's aircraft in Hawaiian's livery: tails N###HA (717
# 787). The flight number stays in the AS form.
